title: Andiam, andiam, bel paggio
subtitle: Barbarina and Cherubino: recitative from Le nozze di Figaro, Act 3
note: Barbarina takes Cherubino home to dress him as a village girl
about: Score: the recitative “Andiam, andiam, bel paggio” (vocal score pages 247-248, 16 bars), from Paul Klengel's piano reduction in the Breitkopf & Härtel vocal score (Edition Breitkopf 1716, about 1900), public domain.
